summary: Configured a persistent Squid forward proxy on node1:3128 and a persistent legacy origin on node2:8081. Only node2 requests to that origin and port are allowed; other ports, other destinations, and all CONNECT tunnels return 403. Both nodes passed sequential reboot-persistence verification with changed boot identities. Ubuntu 24.04.3 and kernel 6.8.0-71 were preserved.
actions_performed: Configured Squid ACLs for node2 → node2:8081 only, with CONNECT explicitly denied.
Created and enabled legacy-origin.service using the existing staged application without modifying its content.
Verified the proxied handbook matches the staged SHA-256.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified service recovery.
